title: Cartwise Rewards Offers on Cartwise+ Membership Annual Upgrades
content:
A rewards offer taken off the charge when a Cartwise+ Membership member moves up from a monthly plan to Cartwise+ Annual follows the member's Cartwise Rewards tier.

| Member's Cartwise Rewards tier | Offer taken off (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cartwise Rewards Gold, Platinum or Diamond | 10.00 |
| Cartwise Rewards Silver or Bronze | 5.00 |
| any other tier, or no Cartwise Rewards account | 0.00 |

The tier is the one the member's Cartwise Rewards account shows today.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A Cartwise Rewards Platinum member: 10.00 off.
- A Cartwise Rewards Silver member: 5.00 off.
- A Cartwise Rewards Member-tier customer: 0.00 off.
